galactic-evolution-identity-2-f23c86a3.title: Rees-Ostriker Cooling Criterion
galactic-evolution-identity-2-f23c86a3.interpretation: Dictates that protogalactic gas within a dark matter halo will undergo rapid, runaway gravitational collapse and fragmentation into stars if its radiative cooling time is shorter than its gravitational free-fall time.
galactic-evolution-identity-2-f23c86a3.symmetry_origin: Derived from the virial temperature equilibrium and radiative loss rates of diffuse plasmas in hydrostatic balance.
galactic-evolution-identity-2-f23c86a3.limits_and_boundary: Marks the boundary between rapid, dynamical collapse regimes (low-mass halos below 10^{12} solar masses) and slow, quasi-static cooling regimes where gas remains supported by thermal pressure.

semantic_variables.t_{\\text{cool}}: Radiative cooling timescale of the baryonic gas
semantic_variables.t_{\\text{ff}}: Gravitational free-fall timescale of the gas halo
